name: The Voice Memo That Almost Got Deleted
why_it_works: A raw voice memo is intimate: it feels like being let into a private moment. Fans crave the before of a song they will hear, and the almost-deleted stake makes them feel lucky the song exists. That gratitude turns into a stream and a save.

hook.pattern: Silent first frame of a voice memo timestamp, then the rough memo audio plays under the next beat.
examples: The first take of {{song_title}} was a voice memo.

variables.name: memo_time
variables.description: The timestamp on the original memo, e.g. 3:12 a.m.; never followed by a period in the script

variables.name: where_written
variables.example: in my car outside my old job

variables.name: almost_quit
variables.example: I thought the chorus was too simple

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Where to listen or what to do, starting with a capital letter, spoken, 6 words or fewer
variables.example: Stream it now, link in bio

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 close-up of a phone screen showing a voice memo app with a single recording titled with a timestamp {{memo_time}}, dark bedroom, screen glow on a hand
Vertical photo of a figure seen from behind in a parked car at night, notebook on the steering wheel, dashboard glow, rain on the windshield, face not visible

beats.voiceover: And I almost deleted it, because {{almost_quit}}.

visual.prompt: Vertical photo of a cluttered home studio desk, laptop open on a session, cold blue monitor glow, crumpled lyric sheets, empty chair
Client-supplied live footage or photo of {{artist}} performing {{song_title}}, warm amber stage light, with the finished master playing

craft.notes: Play the real rough voice memo under beats 2 and 3 over the quiet instrumental bed from the music block, then hard-cut to the artist's own finished master on the turn. The contrast in sound quality is the reveal. Keep the visuals dark and small until the real stage shot.

do_not: Use another artist's song, melody or lyrics in the memo
Imitate a named artist's voice or style
Polish the memo audio; it must sound rough
Generate a stand-in for the artist's real song or performance

music.feel: sparse lo-fi piano bed, soft room tone

compliance: The finished song and stage shot are the artist's own real recording and footage; the generated music is only an instrumental bed, never the song itself
